Train SWAE with Clustering Head

Source: R/MMD_Vae.R
trainSWAEClustering.Rd

Trains a Sliced Wasserstein Autoencoder with an additional clustering head for joint batch correction and clustering. The model learns to reconstruct data while simultaneously learning cluster assignments.

Usage

trainSWAEClustering(
  trainData,
  useMarkers,
  nClusters = 10L,
  pseudoLabels = NULL,
  epochs = 100L,
  latentDim = 16L,
  lambda = 0.1,
  lambdaCluster = 1,
  numProjections = 50L,
  batchSize = 32L,
  learningRate = 0.001,
  hiddenSizes = c(23L, 19L),
  clusterWarmup = 10L,
  jointFineTune = FALSE,
  jointEpochs = 30L,
  labelSmoothing = 0,
  contrastiveLoss = FALSE,
  lambdaContrastive = 0.1,
  contrastiveTemp = 0.5,
  useMMD = FALSE,
  lambdaMMD = 0.1,
  mmdBatchAlign = FALSE,
  lambdaMmdBatch = 0.1,
  batchCol = "sample_id",
  contrastivePretraining = FALSE,
  contrastivePretrainEpochs = 20L,
  lambdaContrastivePretrain = 0.5,
  augNoiseScale = 0.1,
  augDropoutRate = 0.1,
  dropout = 0,
  useBatchNorm = FALSE,
  useLayerNorm = FALSE,
  weightDecay = 0,
  lrSchedule = "none",
  lrDecaySteps = 1000L,
  lrDecayRate = 0.96,
  earlyStoppingPatience = 0L,
  valSplit = 0.1,
  useContractive = FALSE,
  lambdaContractive = 0.1,
  useSCARF = FALSE,
  scarfCorruptionRate = 0.3,
  lambdaSCARF = 1,
  useAuxiliaryTask = FALSE,
  lambdaAuxiliary = 0.5,
  auxiliaryLabels = NULL,
  auxiliarySampleCol = "sample_id",
  useSwitchTab = FALSE,
  salientDim = NULL,
  lambdaSwitchTab = 1,
  useDSW = FALSE,
  dswMaxIter = 10L,
  dswLambda = 1,
  valData = NULL,
  seed = 1994
)

Arguments

trainData

Data frame or matrix of training data.

useMarkers

Character vector; names of marker columns to use.

nClusters

Integer; number of clusters. Default is 10.

pseudoLabels

Optional factor or integer vector of cluster labels for supervision. If provided, uses supervised cross-entropy loss. If NULL, uses DEC-style self-training.

epochs

Integer; number of training epochs. Default is 100.

latentDim

Integer; dimensionality of latent space. Default is 16.

lambda

Numeric; weight for Sliced Wasserstein loss. Default is 0.1.

lambdaCluster

Numeric; weight for clustering loss. Default is 1.0.

numProjections

Integer; number of random projections for SW distance. Default is 50.

batchSize

Integer; batch size. Default is 32.

learningRate

Numeric; learning rate. Default is 1e-3.

hiddenSizes

Integer vector; sizes of hidden layers. Default is c(23, 19).

clusterWarmup

Integer; epochs before adding clustering loss. Default is 10. Allows the encoder to learn basic representations before clustering.

jointFineTune

Logical; if TRUE, adds Stage 3 joint fine-tuning where encoder, decoder, and clustering head are all trained together. Default is FALSE.

jointEpochs

Integer; number of epochs for joint fine-tuning. Default is 30.

labelSmoothing

Numeric; label smoothing factor (0-1). Default is 0.0 (disabled). Values like 0.1 can reduce overconfidence and improve generalization.

contrastiveLoss

Logical; if TRUE, adds supervised contrastive loss in Stage 3 to push same-cluster samples together and different-cluster samples apart. Default is FALSE.

lambdaContrastive

Numeric; weight for contrastive loss. Default is 0.1.

contrastiveTemp

Numeric; temperature for contrastive loss (lower = sharper). Default is 0.5.

useMMD

Logical; if TRUE, adds MMD loss to the training. Default is FALSE.

lambdaMMD

Numeric; weight for MMD loss. Default is 0.1.

mmdBatchAlign

Logical; if TRUE, adds MMD batch alignment loss. Default is FALSE.

lambdaMmdBatch

Numeric; weight for MMD batch alignment loss. Default is 0.1.

batchCol

Character; column name for batch IDs. Default is "sample_id".

contrastivePretraining

Logical; if TRUE, adds contrastive pretraining stage. Default is FALSE.

contrastivePretrainEpochs

Integer; number of epochs for contrastive pretraining. Default is 20.

lambdaContrastivePretrain

Numeric; weight for contrastive pretraining loss. Default is 0.5.

augNoiseScale

Numeric; noise scale for data augmentation. Default is 0.1.

augDropoutRate

Numeric; dropout rate for data augmentation. Default is 0.1.

dropout

Numeric; dropout rate for encoder/decoder layers (0-1). Default is 0.0 (disabled).

useBatchNorm

Logical; if TRUE, add batch normalization layers. Default is FALSE.

useLayerNorm

Logical; if TRUE, add layer normalization instead of batch norm. Default is FALSE.

weightDecay

Numeric; L2 regularization weight for optimizer. Default is 0.0 (disabled).

lrSchedule

Character; learning rate schedule type: "none", "cosine", "exponential". Default is "none".

lrDecaySteps

Integer; steps for learning rate decay (for exponential). Default is 1000.

lrDecayRate

Numeric; decay rate for exponential schedule. Default is 0.96.

earlyStoppingPatience

Integer; epochs without improvement before stopping. 0 = disabled. Default is 0.

valSplit

Numeric; fraction of training data to use for validation if valData not provided. Default is 0.1.

useContractive

Logical; if TRUE, adds contractive regularization (DeepCAE). Default is FALSE.

lambdaContractive

Numeric; weight for contractive loss. Default is 0.1.

useSCARF

Logical; if TRUE, enables SCARF-style pretraining. Default is FALSE.

scarfCorruptionRate

Numeric; fraction of features to corrupt in SCARF (0-1). Default is 0.3.

lambdaSCARF

Numeric; weight for SCARF contrastive loss. Default is 1.0.

useAuxiliaryTask

Logical; if TRUE, adds sample-level classification as auxiliary task. Default is FALSE.

lambdaAuxiliary

Numeric; weight for auxiliary task loss. Default is 0.5.

auxiliaryLabels

Vector of sample-level labels for auxiliary task.

auxiliarySampleCol

Character; column name for sample IDs. Default is "sample_id".

useSwitchTab

Logical; if TRUE, enables SwitchTab-style salient/mutual feature decoupling. Default is FALSE.

salientDim

Integer; dimensionality of salient features. Default is NULL (same as latentDim).

lambdaSwitchTab

Numeric; weight for SwitchTab losses. Default is 1.0.

valData

Optional validation data.

seed

Integer; random seed for reproducibility. Default is 1994.

Value

List containing encoder, decoder, clusterHead, training history, and optionally salientEncoder (if useSwitchTab) and auxiliaryHead (if useAuxiliaryTask).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# With pseudo-labels from FuseSOM
model <- trainSWAEClustering(
  trainData = train_data,
  useMarkers = markers,
  nClusters = 11,
  pseudoLabels = sce$clusters,
  epochs = 100,
  latentDim = 16,
  lambda = 0.1,
  lambdaCluster = 1.0
)

# Batch correction via decode
latent <- as.matrix(model$encoder(as.matrix(data[, markers])))
corrected <- as.matrix(model$decoder(latent))

# Get cluster assignments
clusters <- as.matrix(model$clusterHead(latent))
cluster_labels <- max.col(clusters)
} # }
